title: One BUG
body: I’ve been using this app for quite a while now, and I really like it. It’s neat, easy to use and has a lot of options. However I recently discovered a bug, or rather a minor inconvenience. If I have a big gadget with my custom to do list, if I have more than 6 elements in that list, it only displays 4 in the widget, but if I have 5 elements, it displays all of them. Its a minor thing, but it’s so unsatisfying and also frustrating that I can’t see one more thing I have to do that day, because for some reason in the widget is being cut off. In rest this app is super amazing and I hope you can fix this issue :)

title: Flawed by design
body: This app only syncs when you open it. What this means is that, if you add a task with a reminder for later that day on your desktop computer and never open the app on your phone in the meantime, you will never be notified about that task on your phone! Kind of defeating the purpose of having this in the first place. Background syncing would fix this. The app is useless without it.

title: Great to-do app
body: Don't look at the 1 star reviews. This is a great but simplistic app that aims and succeeds at helping you manage your tasks. Provides several ways to help you organize yourself if you wish. You can obviously add notes and prioritize items. If you're looking for a simple to-do app, give it a shot. If you're shopping for an all-in-one tool to manage tasks, notes, write diary entries and teach you how to play guitar, maybe say pass to this.
